_: Settings for the On screen mod. paths.home_only: list only paths under your home (agents' scratch folders under /tmp stay out). paths.ignore: never list these folders or anything in them (~ is your home). commands.enter: what Enter does on a command: run-split (run it in a new terminal beside the pane), paste-split, paste or copy. letters: one character per action, editor id or browser id; browser letters apply to links, editor letters to paths, command letters to commands, so they may overlap. Save to apply.
